```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r}
#| label: load
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SpectraWeaveR)
  library(flowCore)
})
```

## What this vignette covers

The import step reads headers and, where stated, events, and it gives tables of facts: no pass or fail, and no file is edited or dropped without a row. Every value in a call below is "illustrative, choose your own"; the package has no default for any of them.

## Synthetic files

Six small FCS files in a temp folder carry the problems the checks look for: two batches, mixed `$DATE` spellings, one wrong `$TOT`, mixed spillover and apply-flag spellings, one marker spelled two ways, and one file that is not an FCS file.

```{r}
#| label: make-files
set.seed(1)
fcs_dir <- tempfile("import-demo-")
dir.create(fcs_dir)

# One file: three channels (Time plus two fluorescence), markers in $PnS,
# and any extra header keywords.
make_fcs <- function(name, markers, keywords) {
  n_events <- 200
  mat <- cbind(
    Time = seq_len(n_events),
    matrix(
      rnorm(n_events * length(markers), 2000, 500),
      ncol = length(markers),
      dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("B", seq_along(markers), "-A"))
    )
  )
  ff <- flowFrame(mat)
  pData(parameters(ff))$desc <- c(NA, markers)
  header <- keyword(ff)
  header[names(keywords)] <- keywords
  keyword(ff) <- header
  path <- file.path(fcs_dir, name)
  write.FCS(ff, path)
  path
}

identity_spill <- "2,B1-A,B2-A,1,0,0,1"
real_spill <- "2,B1-A,B2-A,1,0.12,0.03,1"
mk_a <- c("CD3 BV421", "CD4 BB515")
mk_b <- c("CD3 BV421", "CD4 PE")

fcs_paths <- c(
  s1 = make_fcs("s1.fcs", mk_a, list(
    "$CYT" = "A", "$CYTSN" = "SN1", "$DATE" = "01-MAR-2026",
    "$BTIM" = "09:00:00", "$SPILL" = identity_spill, "APPLYCOMP" = "TRUE"
  )),
  s2 = make_fcs("s2.fcs", mk_a, list(
    "$CYT" = "A", "$CYTSN" = "SN1", "$DATE" = "01-MAR-2026",
    "$BTIM" = "13:30:00", "$SPILL" = real_spill, "APPLYCOMP" = "yes"
  )),
  s3 = make_fcs("s3.fcs", mk_b, list(
    "$CYT" = "B", "$CYTSN" = "SN2", "$DATE" = "05-MAR-2026",
    "$BTIM" = "09:10:00", "$COMP" = "2,1,0.2,0,1", "APPLYCOMP" = "FALSE"
  )),
  s4 = make_fcs("s4.fcs", mk_b, list(
    "$CYT" = "B", "$CYTSN" = "SN2", "$DATE" = "05-MAR-2026",
    "$BTIM" = "09:50:00", "$SPILL" = real_spill, "APPLYCOMP" = "no"
  )),
  # The marker is spelled "CD8a" here and "CD8" in the next file.
  s5 = make_fcs("s5.fcs", c("CD3 BV421", "CD8a APC"), list(
    "$CYT" = "B", "$CYTSN" = "SN2", "$DATE" = "5 March 2026",
    "$BTIM" = "10:20:00"
  )),
  s6 = make_fcs("s6.fcs", c("CD3 BV421", "CD8 APC"), list(
    "$CYT" = "B", "$CYTSN" = "SN2", "$DATE" = "05-MAR-2026",
    "$BTIM" = "10:40:00", "$SPILL" = identity_spill
  ))
)

# Make $TOT of s4 wrong on disk: same width, so no offset moves. This edits
# a file this vignette made itself, never a user file.
s4_raw <- readBin(fcs_paths[["s4"]], "raw", file.size(fcs_paths[["s4"]]))
# Blank the nul bytes of the data section so the text can be searched.
s4_text <- s4_raw
s4_text[s4_text == as.raw(0)] <- as.raw(32)
s4_pos <- regexpr("$TOT|200", rawToChar(s4_text), fixed = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)
s4_raw[s4_pos + 5:7] <- charToRaw("201")
writeBin(s4_raw, fcs_paths[["s4"]])

# One file that is not an FCS file.
junk_path <- file.path(fcs_dir, "junk.fcs")
writeLines("not an fcs file", junk_path)

all_paths <- unname(c(fcs_paths, junk_path))

samples <- data.frame(
  id = c("s1", "s2", "s3", "s4", "s5", "s6", "s7"),
  batch = c("B1", "B1", "B2", "B2", "B2", "B2", "B2"),
  run = c("r1", "r1", "r2", "r2", "r2", "r2", "r2")
)
manifest <- sw_sample_manifest(
  samples,
  sample_id = "id",
  batch = "batch",
  run = "run"
)
```

## I1: bind the manifest to files

A missing argument stops the call and names it, because each of these choices changes which files bind.

```{r}
#| label: bind-missing
bind_msg <- tryCatch(
  sw_manifest_bind_files(manifest, paths = all_paths),
  error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)
)
cat(bind_msg)
```

With every choice given, `s7` has a manifest row and no file, and `junk.fcs` has a file and no row.

```{r}
#| label: bind
bound <- sw_manifest_bind_files(
  manifest,
  paths = all_paths,
  key = "file_stem", # illustrative, choose your own
  case = "exact", # illustrative, choose your own
  recursive = FALSE, # illustrative, choose your own
  on_duplicate_file = "unbind", # illustrative, choose your own
  on_extra_file = "list", # illustrative, choose your own
  nextdata = "bind" # illustrative, choose your own
)
bound$manifest_no_file
bound$file_no_manifest
```

## I2: file integrity

Each file gets one row per item (readable, `$TOT` against rows read, time span, channel set), and the wrong `$TOT` of `s4` shows as `differs`.

```{r}
#| label: integrity
integrity <- sw_fcs_integrity_audit(
  all_paths,
  tot_tolerance = 0, # illustrative, choose your own
  time_keyword = "Time", # illustrative, choose your own
  header_only = FALSE # illustrative, choose your own
)
integrity[integrity$item %in% c("readable", "tot_vs_rows"), c(
  "file", "item", "value", "status", "reason"
)]
```

## I3: header signatures and a panel

Files that share the values of the named keywords share a signature, and the `panel` list shows which markers each file lacks or adds, so `CD8a` in `s5` appears as missing `CD8 APC` and extra `CD8a APC`.

```{r}
#| label: signatures
signatures <- sw_fcs_header_signatures(
  all_paths,
  keywords = c("$CYT", "$CYTSN"), # illustrative, choose your own
  panel = list(T_cells = c("CD3 BV421", "CD4 PE", "CD8 APC")) # illustrative
)
signatures$counts[, c("signature", "n_files", "files")]
signatures$panel_match[, c("file", "status", "missing", "extra")]
```

A reference file also gives the differences of every file against it, which feeds the header-audit figure.

```{r}
#| label: header-audit
header_audit <- sw_fcs_header_audit(
  unname(fcs_paths),
  keywords = c("$CYT", "$CYTSN"), # illustrative, choose your own
  reference = fcs_paths[["s1"]]
)
head(header_audit, 4)
```

## I4: compensation state

Matrix present, matrix is identity and the apply flag are separate columns, so a file with an identity matrix and the flag "TRUE" is visible as such.

```{r}
#| label: compensation
compensation <- sw_fcs_compensation_state(
  all_paths,
  matrix_keywords = c("$SPILLOVER", "$SPILL", "$COMP"), # illustrative
  apply_keywords = "APPLYCOMP", # illustrative, choose your own
  apply_true = c("true", "yes"), # illustrative, choose your own
  apply_false = c("false", "no"), # illustrative, choose your own
  zero_tol = 1e-6, # illustrative, choose your own
  expected_state = NULL # illustrative: no expectation
)
compensation[, c("file", "matrix_present", "matrix_identity", "apply_parsed")]
```

## I5: batch against date

The declared batch is crossed with the date, begin time and serial number; `s5` has a date the format does not parse, so it is listed with that reason and not dropped.

```{r}
#| label: batch-date
batch_date <- sw_fcs_batch_date_check(
  paths = fcs_paths,
  manifest = manifest,
  date_keywords = "$DATE", # illustrative, choose your own
  time_keywords = "$BTIM", # illustrative, choose your own
  serial_keyword = "$CYTSN", # illustrative, choose your own
  date_format = "%d-%b-%Y", # illustrative, choose your own
  time_zone = "UTC", # illustrative, choose your own
  run_gap_hours = 12 # illustrative, choose your own
)
batch_date$files[, c("sample_id", "batch", "date_raw", "date_status", "session")]
batch_date$crosstab
```

## I6: marker and dye map

Each `$PnS` label is split at the separator into marker and dye, and the two spellings of CD8 show as two markers in the marker by batch table.

```{r}
#| label: dye-map
dye_map <- sw_fcs_marker_dye_map(
  unname(fcs_paths),
  batch = c(
    s1.fcs = "B1", s2.fcs = "B1", s3.fcs = "B2",
    s4.fcs = "B2", s5.fcs = "B2", s6.fcs = "B2"
  ),
  separator = " " # illustrative, choose your own
)
dye_map$marker_batch
```

## I9: per-channel signal summary

`sw_fcs_signal_audit()` with `summary` set adds counts, a location and quantiles per file and channel, and a channel with too few events is `not_assessed` with its reason.

```{r}
#| label: signal-summary
# Event matrices of the files that could be read, one per file.
readable <- unname(fcs_paths[names(fcs_paths) != "s4"])
events <- lapply(readable, function(p) exprs(sw_io_read_fcs(p)))
names(events) <- basename(readable)

channel_summary <- sw_fcs_signal_audit(
  events,
  channels = c("B1-A", "B2-A"),
  range_max = NULL,
  range_min = NULL,
  time_channel = NULL,
  time_bin = NULL,
  area_height = NULL,
  area_height_quantile = NULL,
  reference_group = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  summary = list(
    probs = c(0.25, 0.75), # illustrative, choose your own
    min_events = 50, # illustrative, choose your own
    stat = "median" # illustrative, choose your own
  )
)
channel_summary[
  grepl("^summary_", channel_summary$check) & channel_summary$channel == "B1-A",
  c("file", "check", "value")
] |>
  head(6)
```

The `s4` file is left out of `events` here because its `$TOT` is wrong, and I2 above already lists it.

## Report

`sw_report_import()` writes tables, PNG figures with their source data, `provenance.json` and `sessionInfo.txt` into a new folder, and it stops if the folder exists.

```{r}
#| label: report
report_dir <- file.path(tempfile("import-report-"), "run")
dir.create(dirname(report_dir))
import_report <- sw_report_import(
  result = list(
    bound = bound,
    header_audit = header_audit,
    integrity = integrity,
    signatures = signatures,
    compensation = compensation,
    batch_date = batch_date,
    dye_map = dye_map,
    channel_summary = channel_summary
  ),
  out_dir = report_dir
)
names(import_report$tables)
unlist(import_report$figures)
```

Two of the figures follow; they are proposals, so inspect each one before you draw a conclusion from it.

```{r}
#| label: report-figures
#| out-width: 100%
fig_paths <- unlist(import_report$figures)
fig_paths <- fig_paths[file.exists(fig_paths)]
knitr::include_graphics(unname(fig_paths[seq_len(min(2, length(fig_paths)))]))
```

## A public data set

The chunk below is not run, and the availability of FR-FCM-Z4KT on FlowRepository is unverified.

```{r}
#| label: public-set
#| eval: false
# Download the files of FR-FCM-Z4KT into "data/FR-FCM-Z4KT" first. The
# FlowRepository HTTPS certificate has been expired in the past, so check the
# download before you rely on it.
z4kt_paths <- list.files(
  "data/FR-FCM-Z4KT",
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
z4kt_integrity <- sw_fcs_integrity_audit(
  z4kt_paths,
  tot_tolerance = 0, # illustrative, choose your own
  time_keyword = "Time", # illustrative, choose your own
  header_only = FALSE # illustrative, choose your own
)
```
